components.rule: No original game-specific C/assembly is copied into distributable source.
Use only SFX selected from the explicitly CC0-capable 2019 collection; document per-file mapping/checksum.
Do not copy, trace, recolor, upscale or pixel-redraw PinWizz original media. No AI-generated assets.

components.distribution: new human-composed replacement required (or no music initially)
components.rule: Do not reuse or transcribe the original melody unless a separate explicit relicence is obtained.
Preserve category/count/timing behavior, not the original sentences.

components.component: Exact NES nametable/map bytes and tile art
components.license: historical CC BY grant, version unspecified
components.rule: ROM/nametable/map header bytes stay outside distributable; only hashes and behavioral metadata may be retained.

components.component: Level topology / collision geometry / object positions
components.license: provenance attributed to original; do not claim GPL relicensing
components.rule: Implementation may load synthetic/private oracle data now. Before public release of exact topology, retain explicit attribution and complete final legal review or redesign levels.

components.license: historical CC BY grant, version unspecified
components.rule: Do not include in public distributable without a resolved licence basis.

components.license: not treated as an art asset
components.rule: May be used internally/archivally as the project identity. Do not reuse the original logo; perform final trademark/naming review before public launch.

project_rules: Original bytes are never committed to the distributable repo merely because they exist in the archaeology workspace.
Credits are shown on the Credits page, not the main gameplay screen.
New assets must carry a source, author, licence and SHA-256 entry before release.
A component cannot inherit a licence from a related port unless the relevant rights holder explicitly granted it.
